result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely coherent, but several rendering problems stand out: the second 'Popular right now' card is missing its title/metadata block, horizontal carousel items are clipped at the right edge with truncated labels, and the bottom navigation bar appears broken with a stray horizontal line overlapping the icons and unlabeled tabs.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (the pizza image with the '-20%' badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time or cuisine text beneath it, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it. The card ends abruptly at the bottom of the scroll area.
issues.suggestion: Render the title/rating/meta row for every card in the list, or add skeleton placeholders while data loads so the card never appears headless.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar looks broken: a thick dark horizontal line runs across the bar and overlaps/cuts through the search and bookmark icons, and the icons are misaligned (search and bookmark sit adjacent instead of evenly spaced with home and profile).
issues.suggestion: Fix the tab bar layout — remove or reposition the stray divider/indicator element, distribute the four tab items evenly with equal flex, and ensure icons are vertically centered above the safe-area inset.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is cut off by the viewport edge with its name and delivery price truncated mid-word, and there is no visual affordance (peek/gradient) indicating the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding and card widths so the next card peeks in partially, and avoid mid-word clipping by using ellipsis truncation on the label.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is also clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scroll container shows a clear partial chip or add a fade/gradient mask at the edge to signal scrollability.

issues.description: Bottom navigation tabs have icons only with no text labels, and the notification bell with a red dot has no accessible label or count, making state unclear for screen-reader and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add visible text labels under each tab icon and provide accessible names/aria-labels for the bell and unread indicator (e.g. 'Notifications, 3 unread').

issues.description: Favourite (heart) buttons are inconsistently styled: the first card uses a white circle with dark outline heart while the second uses a dark translucent circle with white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button background and icon colour across all cards, using a single treatment that has adequate contrast over any image.

issues.description: Card metadata is inconsistent: 'Fastest near you' items show only delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' items include rating, time and cuisine, and delivery badges ('€0 delivery', '-20%') duplicate information also shown in the text row.
issues.suggestion: Define one consistent metadata pattern per card variant and avoid duplicating the delivery-fee information in both badge and text.
